title: Deploy and remove policy packs, build packs from a tenant, apply proposals

checks.what: Every deploy, removal, undo and proposal write needs an explicit True write gate; the server checks writer, confirmation, assessor and write mode before sign-in
Every pack rule is created DISABLED with a non-enforcing action
Create order is dictionary, engine, application group, rule
Remove/undo order is rule, application group, engine, dictionary; one activation at the end
A tenant or pack that changed between plan and apply refuses the apply (deploy, removal, proposal)
A failure part-way reports partial, skips dependents and records exactly what was created
Removal deletes only tagged objects (or a record's id+name), never name-only lookalikes or another pack's tag
Deploying the same pack twice creates nothing the second time
Every write leaves an object_write audit entry (with run and tenant); no secret in the audit log
Pack files on disk: size, nesting, shape and field types checked; plain blocked plan on failure
Name filter never compiled as a regex
Tenant dictionary names cannot inject terms into engine expressions
deployments.json and rebuilt pack files are 0600 and written atomically
deployments.json read-modify-write is serialised
Tenant fingerprint kept out of summaries; CLI never prints the client secret
Plain-language errors on every failure path; no traceback reaches a response
These modules reach the tenant only through the injected SDK client; no URL is built from input
Pack directories come from the library resolver (server validates pack ids); the rebuild writes only under the pack's configs folder
Older deployment records, BOM-prefixed pack files, digit-string ranks and control-channel dict actions still load
SDK calls used (dlp_dictionary.list_dicts/add_dict/update_dict/delete_dict, dlp_engine.*, dlp_web_rules.*) are unchanged by this work; no new Zscaler API detail was introduced

findings.title: Removal deleted untagged customer objects that only shared a pack or legacy name (e.g. a customer's own 'PCI - High' engine)
findings.fix: A name-only match is kept with a plain reason; only objects carrying the app's provenance tag (or a deployment record's id+name) are removed; the rule picker removes the rest by hand

findings.title: Legacy tag check was a substring test: removing pack 'x' also matched objects tagged '[DLP-Check pack x_more v1]'
findings.fix: The legacy tag must name the pack id whole (followed by space, ']' or end)

findings.title: A pack or pick-mode removal with an empty plan_hash skipped the stale-plan check and deleted an unreviewed plan (including 'remove everything')
findings.fix: remove() and remove_selected() refuse an empty plan_hash; a deployment undo stays bound to its record

findings.title: Module write gates failed open: writes_enabled=None (the default) let deploy, removal and proposal apply write
findings.fix: Deny by default: only writes_enabled is True writes (the server always passes True after its own four gates)

findings.title: plan_hash bound only item statuses and tenant object counts: a pack file edited after preflight, or a tenant rule swapped for another, still applied
findings.fix: The hash covers each item's definition content and the tenant's object names, ids and rule orders

findings.title: Pack files read from disk were trusted: a non-list, scalar entries, wrong field types, deep nesting or a huge file crashed preflight and removal (HTTP 500 with a Python error)
findings.fix: pack_deploy.load_pack_file: 8 MB cap, nesting cap, list-of-objects shape and a per-file field schema; a bad file is a plain blocked plan before the tenant is read

findings.title: Proposal apply re-read the rule before writing but did not compare it with the preview: a change made in between was overwritten
findings.fix: The write is refused when the field (or the rule id behind the name) changed since the preview

findings.title: A rollback with no recorded value (or a proposal with no target) normalised None to '' and would send an empty action/state to ZIA
findings.fix: A missing value stays None and the preview refuses the step

findings.title: Proposal rule writes were audited without the run or tenant
findings.fix: The write runs inside pack_ops.audit_scope(run=proposal_<direction>, tenant=<opaque key>)

findings.title: deployments.json read-modify-write had no lock: two runs finishing together lost a record (and with it the undo)
findings.fix: One module lock around every read-modify-write of the store

findings.title: A deployments store of another shape ({'deployments': null}, a list, non-object records) or an older record without 'kind' crashed the list and undo pages
findings.fix: The store is read as far as it is records; summaries use .get; add() refuses a non-record

findings.title: The from-tenant name filter was compiled as a regular expression and run on tenant names: '(a+)+$' hung the worker (ReDoS)
findings.fix: Literal, case-folded substring with optional ^prefix / suffix$; no regex is ever compiled from it

findings.title: A tenant dictionary name such as 'Py) OR (D:CREDIT_CARD Signal' was pasted into the rebuilt engine expression, rewriting its logic in every tenant the pack is deployed to
findings.fix: Only names that read back as exactly one D:<name> term (dlp_importer.find_refs) and hold no control characters are used; others are listed as ignored

findings.title: The from-tenant rebuild crashed on a malformed rules file after rewriting the dictionaries and engines (half-rewritten pack), leaked file handles and wrote non-atomically
findings.fix: Every current pack file is validated first; the three files are written whole with safe_files.write_private_atomic (0600)

findings.title: Untrusted values of the wrong type crashed two reads: a non-numeric tenant 'proximity' (rebuild) and a non-object entry in a deployment record (undo preview)
findings.fix: The value is dropped or the entry skipped

findings.title: POST /api/dlp-packs/{pack_id}/import records a deployment only when the status is 'applied': objects created by a partial deploy are never recorded, so they cannot be undone
findings.fix: Record applied and partial deploys (from_apply returns None when nothing was created)
findings.proposed_patch:
diff --git a/dlp_api_server.py b/dlp_api_server.py
index 747a9cc..0e89c33 100755
--- a/dlp_api_server.py
+++ b/dlp_api_server.py
@@ -4431,13 +4431,17 @@ async def dlp_pack_import(pack_id: str, req: DLPPackImportRequest, request: Requ
                                                                apply_tweaks=req.apply_tweaks, verify=req.verify, writes_enabled=True,
                                                                log=logs.append, assessor=by))
     result["logs"] = logs
-    if result.get("status") == "applied" and result.get("summary", {}).get("created"):
+    # A partial deploy created objects too: record them, or they can never be undone.
+    if result.get("status") in ("applied", "partial") and result.get("summary", {}).get("created"):
         try:
             import deployments
             creds = _tenant_creds(req)
-            deployments.add(deployments.from_apply(result, tenant_label=tenant_auth.record_label(creds), packs=[pack["id"]],
-                                                   options={"use_rank_0": req.use_rank_0, "apply_tweaks": req.apply_tweaks}, channel_targets={},
-                                                   by=by, **_record_ids(creds)))
+            rec = deployments.from_apply(result, tenant_label=tenant_auth.record_label(creds), packs=[pack["id"]],
+                                         options={"use_rank_0": req.use_rank_0, "apply_tweaks": req.apply_tweaks}, channel_targets={},
+                                         by=by, **_record_ids(creds))
+            if rec:
+                deployments.add(rec)
+                result["deployment_id"] = rec["id"]
         except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 — the deployment happened; only the record failed
             result.setdefault("warnings", []).append(f"The deployment was not recorded for undo: {e}")
     return result

findings.title: PackFromTenantRequest.name_filter is still documented as 'substring/regex' after the filter became literal
findings.proposed_patch:
diff --git a/dlp_api_server.py b/dlp_api_server.py
index 747a9cc..0e89c33 100755
--- a/dlp_api_server.py
+++ b/dlp_api_server.py
@@ -1493,7 +1493,7 @@ def _resolve_pack_ids(pack_ids: List[str]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
 
 class PackFromTenantRequest(TenantCredsRequest):
     """Rebuild a pack from the tenant's own Anchor/Signal dictionaries."""
-    name_filter: str = ""      # substring/regex the dictionary names must match ("" = every custom dictionary)
+    name_filter: str = ""      # literal substring the dictionary names must contain (^prefix, suffix$; "" = every custom dictionary)
     prefix: str = "SRC-"       # engine name prefix
     threshold: int = 4         # Signal matches the engine needs (> N)
     html_threshold: int = 3

findings.title: In 'remove everything' mode an assessor-style tag at the very end of a customer's own description ('[Bob pack q3 v2]') is indistinguishable from a deploy tag
findings.fix: Accepted: the operator reviews every object in the preview (plan_hash-bound) before confirming; a tag needs the deploy's exact shape and position
